fields.why: The stoppage of the flotation tailings thickener flocculant pump was not captured when a fault occurred with the pump, resulting in poor thickener performance and poor process water quality.
fields.design:
Add an alarm in CITECH for each flocculant dosing pump.
- 810-ZM-2295E
- 810-ZM-2295F
- 810-ZM-2295G

So that if one of the flocculant pumps stop and the HPGR is still running (can link to HPGR power) or the CV 0250 conveyor weightometer (140-WIT-0255) reads zero for 1 hour, then RED alarm activates to alert the CRO that the specific flocculant pump has stopped
fields.impact: CROs get a red alarm identifying which flocculant dosing pump has stopped while the plant is running.
